letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, my cutie, every sunrise—whether it kisses the dunes of Dubai or the mango trees of Ahmedabad—reminds me how blessed I am to share this world with you. Our love, fresh as the spring breeze that slipped through the balcony on our wedding day, keeps blooming brighter with each shared laugh and whispered secret. I cherish every moment we stitch together across continents, and I can’t wait for the countless adventures still waiting for us. You are my forever home, wherever we are.
poem:
Across the sand and city lights we roam,  
Your smile turns every place into home.  
In every season, love’s sweet rhyme,  
Together, forever, till the end of time.
